name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate Prisma client
        run: npx prisma generate

      - name: Type check
        run: npm run type-check

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint
